title: Frozen in Time
description: A woman takes a picture of a young girl in mountainous Adjara, one of the most distinct regions in Georgia. The villagers have maintained old ways of life for ages—raising cattle and maintaining close-knit communities. But the mountainous region's isolation from the rest of the country has made it harder for to obtain an education, proper healthcare, and other basic living conditions. Today, many of the villages have been abandoned as inhabitants have migrated to other regions of Georgia as well as abroad—especially Turkey, where the men take on seasonal jobs for additional income.
translated_description: 一名女子在格鲁吉亚最具特色的地区之一——阿贾拉山区，为一名年轻女孩拍照。这里的村民世代延续着古老的生活方式——养牛为生，维系着紧密的社区关系。但山区与国内其他地区的隔绝，使得获取教育、基本医疗及其他生活条件变得愈发困难。如今，许多村庄已被废弃，居民们纷纷迁往格鲁吉亚其他地区乃至海外——尤其是土耳其，男人们在那里从事季节性工作以增加收入。
